Young adults, slim or ordinary build, friendly expressive faces with small simple eyes and confident smiles. No old or obese people. Human ROUND ears. At most TWO separate flat tones per material. TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG alpha background including all gaps, no scenery, ground, drop shadow, colored halo, colored mist, vignette, paper backdrop, border or panel. Subject: exactly ONE young adult VENALIAN CRAFTSWOMAN, representing ordinary citizens and manual trades. Friendly capable youthful face, large head, warm modest smile, brown hair tucked under a plain CREAM LINEN HEADSCARF tied behind her head. Simple rust-red fitted sleeveless early Italian working bodice over a cream linen blouse with practical sleeves rolled to the elbows, a plain sage-green calf-length work skirt and small linen apron, closed brown leather shoes. No costly embroidery, jewelry, noble insignia, weapons or beggar's rags. This is useful ordinary workwear, not poverty.

She hugs ONE COMICALLY LARGE WICKER TOOL BASKET at hip height, supporting it with her left forearm; two simple wooden-handled tools and a little folded linen protrude visibly from the basket. Her right hand cheerfully holds ONE small wooden-handled mallet upright next to the basket. The basket is humorously full and broad, but must not conceal her face, hands or shoes. She looks ready to get on with a job, standing upright with a jaunty little lean, not bowing or asking for charity. Exactly two arms and two hands. Endearing humor comes from the oversized practical basket, never from humiliation. Exactly one full figure.
